decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Detailed drawings of the shop front shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period 3 years or until the Town Centre Redevelopment is completed whichever is the sooner.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the sales area (as confirmed by letter dated 30/01/04) shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - Before the building is first occupied, details of the disabled W.C  shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writng and approved,and shall be installed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and shall be permanently maintained thereafter until the redevelopment of the site.(As confirmed by letter dated 30/01/04.)
description: Installation of new shop fronts incorporating internal alterations to provide a show home to existing unit
